title: Summon and Strike
source: Engine-ready authored setup/solution for this pass; canonical A01 solution is in canon_reference. No decoded GBA fixed-board table was available when this script was authored.
notes: One Normal Summon of a Level 4 monster, one direct attack. Gemini Elf has 1900 ATK.

canon_reference.setup_status: unknown in A01; this pass ships an engine-ready authored setup
solution_steps: Activate Snatch Steal and choose Master of Oz as the target.
Counter your opponent's Imperial Order with Royal Surrender.
Enter Battle Phase and attack with both monsters.
